overview.query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ROW("complaints", [Complaint Count], "yes", [Timely Yes Count], "no", [Untimely No Count], "unknown", [Unknown Flag Count], "known", [Known Flag Count], "timely_rate", [Timely Response Rate], "untimely_share", [Untimely Share], "unknown_rate", [Unknown Flag Rate], "valid_routing", [Valid Routing Count], "invalid_routing", [Invalid Routing Count], "median_routing_days", [Median Routing Days]), FILTER(ALL('Geography'), 'Geography'[State] IN {"CA", "NY"}))
